description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git svn info' command. It includes test setup code, version checks, and multiple test cases verifying the output and behavior of 'git svn info' with various paths, URL options, and file statuses in a Subversion repository.

methods.name: test_cmp_info
methods.description: Function to compare SVN info output, excluding the 'Text Last Updated' line for consistency.
